label: Timing chain tensioner failure causing engine damage
symptom: Timing chain stretches and can jump teeth, potentially causing catastrophic engine failure; chain slack and noise if oil pressure is low.
cause: Tensioner relies on proper oil level and pressure; design prone to failure.
fix: Replace timing chain and tensioner with updated parts.
warning_signs: Engine rattling or noise on startup
inspection_advice: Check service history for timing chain replacement; listen for rattling on cold start.
notes: Merged issues: timing_chain_tensioner_failure, oil_pressure_dependent_tensioner, timing_chain_failure, noisy_engine_acceleration (as potential symptom).

label: Timing chain tensioner failure
symptom: Potential for catastrophic engine damage due to timing chain or tensioner failure. Rattle when starting with a cold engine, risking serious engine damage.
cause: Timing chain tensioner failure
fix: Requires staying on top of timing chain service as a critical maintenance item to prevent failure.
warning_signs: Rattle when starting with a cold engine
inspection_advice: Check for timing chain service history and listen for cold start rattles.
notes: Merged from 'timing_belt_rattle_failure' (specific to 2.0_TSI_R) and broader timing chain issues on EA888 engines. Note: EA113 (belt) vs EA888/EA111 (chain) distinction.

notes: Common on turbocharged diesel engines.

label: Premature timing chain wear on early EA111 engines

cause: Premature wear of timing chain components.
fix: Replace timing chain, tensioner, and guides.
inspection_advice: Check service history for timing chain replacement; listen for startup rattle.
notes: Affects EA111 chain-driven petrol engines up to 2011.

label: Premature timing chain and tensioner wear on early engines
symptom: Timing chain mechanism can wear before 100,000 km, sometimes requiring replacement as early as 20,000-30,000 km. Early weak version of the timing chain tensioner can fail, potentially causing catastrophic engine damage.
cause: Premature wear of timing chain components. Failure of the weak early-design timing chain tensioner.
fix: Replace timing chain, tensioner, and guides. Replace with updated timing chain tensioner.
inspection_advice: Check service history for timing chain replacement; listen for startup rattle. Verify if the updated tensioner has been installed; check for startup rattle.
notes: Affects EA111 chain-driven petrol engines up to 2011. Critical issue on EA888 engines (1.8/2.0 TSI) up to mid-2012.

label: Weak timing chain tensioner failure on early EA888
symptom: Early weak version of the timing chain tensioner can fail, potentially causing catastrophic engine damage.
cause: Failure of the weak early-design timing chain tensioner.
fix: Replace with updated timing chain tensioner.
warning_signs: Timing chain rattle, especially on startup
inspection_advice: Verify if the updated tensioner has been installed; check for startup rattle.
notes: Critical issue on EA888 engines (1.8/2.0 TSI) up to mid-2012.
